DOWNFALL-PRISMATIC_OPTION.title: Kaleidoscope and Prismatic Gem Option
DOWNFALL-PRISMATIC_OPTION.hover.desc:
Controls which characters' cards Kaleidoscope and Prismatic Gem can pull from (doesn't affect other mods).

Same: only Downfall cards if you're a Downfall character, vanilla cards if you're a base-game character.
DOWNFALL-HIDE_AUTOMATON.title: Disable Automaton
DOWNFALL-HIDE_AUTOMATON.hover.desc: Disables Automaton entirely. It will not be loaded, and will not appear anywhere. Requires a restart to take effect.

DOWNFALL-ENABLE_COMPENDIUM_TOOLS.title: Compendium Search Tools
DOWNFALL-ENABLE_COMPENDIUM_TOOLS.hover.d: Internal tooling for finding content while developing Downfall: a search and character/rarity filter sidebar on the relic collection and potion lab, and a Singleplayer Cards tickbox in the card library. Not needed for normal play. Takes effect the next time those screens open.
DOWNFALL-SHOW_ART_SUBMISSION_BUTTON.hove: Shows or hides the "Downfall Art Submission" button on the main menu.
DOWNFALL-UPLOAD_METRICS.title: Upload Gameplay Data
DOWNFALL-UPLOAD_METRICS.hover.desc:
Gameplay data is sent to help fix bugs and balance the mod. Only sent when playing as a Downfall character.

Personally identifying information is NOT collected.
